+def _is_child_path(path, parent):
+    """Return whether path resolves within parent, including parent itself."""
+    try:
+        b_path = os.path.realpath(to_bytes(path, errors='surrogate_or_strict'))
+        b_parent = os.path.realpath(to_bytes(parent, errors='surrogate_or_strict'))
+        b_relative_path = os.path.relpath(b_path, b_parent)

+    b_parent_prefix = b_parent_dir + to_bytes(os.path.sep, errors='surrogate_or_strict')
+    return b_relative_path == b_current_dir or (
+        b_relative_path != b_parent_dir and not b_relative_path.startswith(b_parent_prefix)
